verify_detail: firmed via `nerve_inspect` that the app process (PID 25788) was no longer running immediately after the crash.\n\n**Note on environment:** this device (Pixel 8 Pro, serial `<REDACTED-1>`) has a stuck/leaked `UiAutomation` registration from an unrelated prior session, which breaks `uiautomator dump`/UI-tree tooling (`nerve_elements`/`nerve_state`). This is unrelated to the BenchTarget bug but means a device reboot may be needed before running further automated UI-tree-based tests on this device.'
